supplement_requests.gap_question: What are the absolute quantitative concentrations (μM or ng/mL) of inosine measured directly in human solid tumor tissue samples from ICI-treated patients, and how do these correlate with response outcomes?
supplement_requests.success_criteria: Identification of at least one study reporting absolute inosine concentration values in human tumor tissue (not just plasma stratification) with statistical correlation to ICI efficacy endpoints (ORR, PFS, or OS).

supplement_requests.success_criteria: Identification of comparative safety data showing irAE rates stratified by ICI regimen type in FMT intervention studies, enabling assessment of regimen-dependent toxicity risk.
